items.name: DOE grant reinstatement, Tonopah Flats Lithium Project
items.claim: American Battery Technology Company won its appeal for reinstatement of a $57 million competitive grant from the U.S. Department of Energy that had previously been terminated, supporting construction of the first processing train at the Tonopah Flats Lithium Project.
items.source_excerpt: ABTC announced that it had successfully won its appeal with the U.S. Department of Energy and had its previously terminated grant for $57 million supporting the $115 million construction of the first processing train at the TFLP fully reinstated.

items.name: Tonopah Flats Lithium Project, first processing train
items.claim: The first processing train under construction at the Tonopah Flats Lithium Project carries a total construction cost of $115 million, backed by the reinstated DOE grant.
